[[Olympique de Marseille]] won '''Division 1 season 1988/1989''' of the [[Ligue de Football Professionnel|French Association Football League]] with 73 points.

Promoted from [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], who will play in [[French soccer Division 1 1989/1990|Division 1 season 1989/1990]]
* [[Olympique Lyonnais]]: Champion of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]], winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group B
* [[FC Mulhouse]]: Runner-up, winner of [[Ligue 2|Division 2]] group A
* [[Stade Brest]]: Third place, winner of barrages against [[RC Strasbourg]]
